_comment_evsEnvVersion: Value sent to the EVS CreateEnvironment API as 'vcfVersion'. Must be 'SELF_DEPLOYED' for our flow (EVS is never asked to deploy VCF; Phase 3 does it).
_comment_esxVersion: Optional override. If omitted, the latest ESXi version matching vcfInstallerProductVersion is auto-resolved via the EVS get-versions API. Set to an exact build string to pin (e.g. 'ESXi-9.1.0.0100.25433460').
_comment_vcfInstallerProductVersion: REQUIRED. Full VCF product version baked into the installer OVA (e.g. '9.0.2.0' or '9.1.0.0'). Sent as the top-level 'version' field on the bringup spec. Check the installer UI or the OVA file name for the exact value.
